editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FOREX.com scores 8.6 out of 10 from NAFT in May 2026. A publicly traded, NASDAQ-listed broker with seven Tier-1 regulatory licences — one of the very few legitimate options for US retail forex traders. RAW pricing from 0.0 pips at $7 per $100k is competitive, execution speed averages 60ms, and platform choice includes MT4, MT5, TradingView, and NinjaTrader. The Gain Capital UK licence surrender is a corporate restructuring being managed responsibly under StoneX Financial Ltd. No crypto funding and limited payment methods are the main friction points. A legitimate, institutional-grade broker that trades transparency for flexibility.
